adjudication.rationale: In `GroupsController#members`, `limit = (params[:limit] || 50).to_i` and `offset = params[:offset].to_i` are used directly in `group.users.order(:username_lower).limit(limit).offset(offset)` with no validation/clamping. Since `to_i` will preserve negative numbers from input, negative `limit`/`offset` can reach the SQL `LIMIT/OFFSET` clause and plausibly cause a DB error/500 instead of a handled 4xx response. The diff also expands this paging logic to all groups (not just automatic), increasing exposure.
